'''''Pogonatum''''' is a genus of [[moss]]es — commonly called '''spike moss''' — which contains approximately 70 species that cover a [[cosmopolitan distribution]]. It can be seen mostly in Asian countries with a tropical climate.

==Species==
There are about 156 species known in all, 9 in North America.
